symptom: Resident storyboard launcher provider prompt omits available image_to_video models
direct_cause: listAvailableModelsForAgent requests the picker default text_to_video and text_to_image modes only
class_root: Agent catalog capture must cover all published media input modes, not one picker default

invariants: Every reference-only published image/video model available through the existing catalog projection participates in agent model capture
generality_proof: The sole listAvailableModelsForAgent function collects both existing text and reference input mode projections, with existing vendor/model deduplication; all callers consume the same complete entries.
